boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-cost activities for GVSU students and nearby visitors, from campus recreation to Ottawa County open spaces.

cards.title: See the GVSU Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Haas Center for Performing Arts, Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Stop into the gallery during its posted hours, take in the current work together, and use the artwork as a low-pressure conversation starter.
cards.short_summary: A free public gallery visit inside the Haas Center for Performing Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU states that admission to the GVSU Art Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Reflect Revive Reshape — GVSU Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: The source lists the gallery at 1121 Haas Center for Performing Arts and identifies free public admission.

cards.title: Climb at the GVSU wall
cards.subtitle: Climbing Center, Fieldhouse B170
cards.notes: Bring a campus friend to an Open Climb session, check in with staff, and try routes at your own pace; first-time climbers get an overview.
cards.short_summary: Indoor climbing with free access for GVSU students and staff.
cards.evidence_claim: The GVSU Climbing Center says GV students and staff climb for free, with rental gear available for those who need it.
cards.access_notes: Check the official page for Open Climb times; climbers must check in before using the wall.

cards.title: Learn a top-rope belay
cards.subtitle: GVSU Climbing Center, Allendale
cards.notes: Ask for the basic belay lesson during Open Climb or watch for a scheduled workshop; it pairs hands-on practice with a staff evaluation.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost route into GVSU’s top-rope belay qualification.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU lists its Top-Rope Belay Lesson as free for GVSU students and available on request during Open Climb hours.
cards.source_title: Technical Skill Workshops — GVSU Outdoor Adventures
cards.access_notes: For GVSU students; the page says Open Climb lessons need no registration, while scheduled offerings use the events calendar.

cards.title: Try Intro to Indoor Climbing
cards.subtitle: GVSU Climbing Center, Allendale
cards.notes: Register when a session is listed, then learn the wall’s equipment and movement basics in a small group before practicing independently.
cards.short_summary: A free introductory climbing workshop with equipment and technique instruction.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU describes Intro to Indoor Climbing as a free, single-day, in-person workshop offered two to three times per semester.
cards.source_title: Technical Skill Workshops — GVSU Outdoor Adventures
cards.access_notes: Registration is required; consult the official Outdoor Adventures events calendar for currently scheduled sessions.

cards.title: Reserve a racquetball court
cards.subtitle: Fieldhouse Complex, Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Reserve a one-hour court with a friend, or drop in if one is available; bring your preferred racquetball gear and keep the game casual.
cards.short_summary: Three Fieldhouse courts can be reserved at no charge by GVSU students.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU says Fieldhouse Complex racquetball-court reservations are free for GVSU students.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Racquetball Court — GVSU Athletic and Recreation Facilities
cards.access_notes: Reservations are recommended but not required and may be made in one-hour increments up to one week ahead.

cards.title: Make a fitness plan together
cards.subtitle: Recreation Center, Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Book an Anchor Into Fitness meeting to assess your current routine and leave with a personalized plan you can use at the Recreation Center.
cards.short_summary: A free GVSU student fitness assessment and personalized-plan service.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU lists Anchor Into Fitness as free for GVSU students and says it includes a fitness assessment and personalized plan.
cards.source_title: Fitness & Wellness — Grand Valley State University
cards.access_notes: The official page identifies the Fitness Services office in the Recreation Center and says training services are available by appointment.

cards.title: Apply for an OA mentorship
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Adventures, Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Apply during the stated window if you have time for a six-week fall commitment, then learn how to facilitate outdoor and adventure-based activities.
cards.short_summary: A free student mentorship program focused on outdoor leadership skills.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU calls the Outdoor Adventures Leadership Mentorship Program free and lists currently enrolled GVSU students among its requirements.
cards.source_title: Adventure Leadership Mentorship Program — GVSU Outdoor Adventures
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled GVSU students with at least two semesters remaining; the program includes a fall-break leadership trip.

cards.title: Walk Eastmanville Bayou
cards.subtitle: Eastmanville Bayou, 13507 68th Avenue, Allendale
cards.notes: Use the open space for a daytime hike beside wetlands and Grand River frontage; stay aware that natural-surface routes are lightly developed.
cards.short_summary: A free Allendale open-space walk with wetlands and riverfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Ottawa County lists hiking at Eastmanville Bayou and states there are no entry or launch fees.
cards.access_notes: Open 5 a.m.–10 p.m.; natural-surface trails may be unsigned, so use the county’s park guidance and follow posted rules.

cards.title: Pack a picnic at the bayou
cards.subtitle: Eastmanville Bayou, Allendale
cards.notes: Bring food you already have, claim a picnic area or the small shelter when unreserved, and pair the meal with a riverside walk.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission outdoor meal stop near Grand River frontage.
cards.evidence_claim: Ottawa County lists picnic areas and a small picnic shelter at Eastmanville Bayou, where there are no entry or launch fees.
cards.access_notes: Open 5 a.m.–10 p.m. Follow Ottawa County Parks rules; this card assumes you bring any food or supplies rather than purchasing onsite.

cards.entity_name: Grand River Open Space off-trail hiking
cards.title: Explore Grand River Open Space
cards.subtitle: Grand River Open Space, 10849 Linden Drive, Allendale
cards.notes: Meet for an easygoing daylight walk through the wetland edge, keeping to safe conditions and checking the site details before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A free Allendale wetland open space with Grand River waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Ottawa County states Grand River Open Space has off-trail hiking and cross-country skiing, with no entry or launch fees.
cards.source_title: Grand River Open Space — Ottawa County Parks
cards.access_notes: Open 5 a.m.–10 p.m. The county describes it as undeveloped; it has a small parking area and information kiosk, and hunting is permitted under DNR laws.
